description:
Fifteen seconds of video with someone new. Then you both decide.

Tap Start and you are on camera with one other person. A clock runs. If you both tap More time, you keep talking. If not, the call ends by itself and you each meet someone new. If you both tap Keep, you swap handles. If only one of you does, nothing is shared.

No account. No profile. No sign up.

Built to be safe:
- 18 and over only, with the rules agreed before your camera ever turns on.
- Report cuts the call. Three reports in a day bans that person, and reports are reviewed by a person.
- Block means you are never matched with that person again.
- Slurs are masked in chat before anyone sees them.
- Video goes straight between the two of you. It never touches our server and nothing is recorded.

Nobody around? Momo, our monkey, gives you a practice call while you wait, and a real person takes over the moment one arrives.

Works on iPhone, Mac and the web at oohaah.jaybulb.com, all in one lobby.
promotionalText: Fifteen seconds with someone new. Both tap More time to keep talking, or meet someone else.
